title: Stratified Latency + Cost Tileboard prototype for model & route rollups
creator: Aisha Moreno
description: Goal: Create a compact, actionable tileboard that surfaces per-model and per-route latency distributions, throughput, and token cost attribution side-by-side so SREs and product engineers can quickly triage regressions and validate rollouts. This ticket covers interaction flows, high-fidelity tiles, chart specs for each tile, drilldown pathways to per-request traces, and handoff artifacts for front-end engineering and telemetry queries.
chart_specs: Latency Distribution (main tile): stacked violin + P50/P90/P99 annotation; x-axis latency (ms), y normalized density; hover shows sample count and example request IDs; visual target: P99 in red if > SLA threshold
Throughput Sparkline (mini-tile): 1h/6h/24h toggle; area sparkline with 95% confidence band and per-minute resolution; clicking opens throughput timeseries panel

Token Flow Waterfall: stacked bar by token attribution (prompt, completion, rerank, tool output) with absolute token count and cost-per-token overlay; each stack segment is clickable to filter traces by token type
Cost Attribution Ribbon: horizontal stacked normalized bars showing cost by model variant, region, and route; shows cost-per-1000-tokens and delta vs previous period; supports currency toggles

Latency Heatmap (route matrix): small-multiples grid of route x model variant with color by median latency; cell drilldown opens per-route microtraces; default aggregation window: last 1h and last 24h comparisons
Regression Flagging overlay: automatic diffing highlight when P95 increases by >20% vs baseline; flag includes quick actions for canary rollback or run smoke evals
decisions: Use tile-first layout (compact 3-column responsive) to enable scanning across multiple models without deep navigation
Primary latency visualization will be violin + quantile markers rather than boxplot to better show multimodal latencies from hybrid workloads
Include cost ribbons in the same visual plane as token waterfall to make cost/latency tradeoffs immediately visible
Default timeframe short (1h) with quick toggles to 6h/24h; heavyweight aggregations (30d) available in drilldown only
Accessibility: all tiles must have text alternatives and keyboard focus states; color palette to use both hue + pattern for high/low flags
